title: ActionCall
description: Forward an action to the exact adapter instance bound by `bot`.

action.description: Protocol action name. No implicit retry is permitted.

BotRef.description: An account attached to one host-assigned adapter instance (including its generation).

adapter_instance_id.description: Host-assigned adapter instance ID; never a plugin-selected routing identity.

self_id.description: Protocol account identifier represented as a string without precision loss.
